user.title: Comelit ViP intercom
user.description: Enter the address of the Wi-Fi monitor. Leave the token empty to read it from the monitor's installer web interface.

reauth_confirm.title: The intercom rejected the token
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant is no longer accepted by the intercom at {host}. Give it a new user token, or leave the token empty and enter the installer password to pick a user again. The address cannot be changed here.

pick_user.title: Which user should Home Assistant be?
pick_user.description: Each entry is one paired device. Pick a slot that no phone uses; two clients on the same user interfere with each other's calls. Add a device from the intercom's Users page if none is spare.

error.invalid_token: The intercom rejected this user token.
error.no_token: No app user was found on the intercom. Pair the Comelit app first, or enter a token.

abort.reauth_failed: The entry being re-authenticated has gone.

init.title: Streaming and recording
init.description: The monitor sends video only during a call and allows one at a time, so a stream makes the wall monitor unusable while it runs.

data.expose_stream: Let other devices reach the stream
data.rtsp_host: Address other devices should use (for example for Frigate)
data.record_on_ring: Record a clip when someone rings
data.snapshot_on_ring: Take a picture when somebody rings

data_description.expose_stream: Off, only Home Assistant can open the stream. On, any device on the network can, and each open stream holds a call on the panel, during which the wall monitor cannot be used.
